entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to confirm that security mode control procedure has been completed successfully.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to activate integrity protection and ciphering for NAS signaling.

entities.name: IMEISV
entities.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity and Software Version number information element.

relations.description: Security mode complete message is sent as part of the security mode control procedure.
Security mode complete message may contain the IMEISV information element.
Security mode complete message is triggered by the successful completion of security mode control procedure.
